author: luring_lurker
body: I play alone, I've never met anyone IRL who plays it, and I don't feel like I'm missing anything except some buddies to hang around with while I play (like how I do with other location-based games). Provided I'm a low profile player, but all of the co-op features can be handled also with party members who live far away form you, the only constrain might be organizing your timings (which is only really a constrain if you want to grind hard).

author: TheWuif
body: you can also take a look at the game Heroes of Aethric (https://playorna.com/aethric/) which is basically the same game but without GPS features so it doesn't matter where you live.

author: permaculturegeek
body: Few opponents means you can do very well in the conquerors guild. I have over 4000 crownships. I had a strong opponent nearby for a while, so a number of settlements reached "high contest" status which massively boosts their rewards. My daily orns are maxed out (5.5M), materials aren't at their limit yet, but total 2.3k daily. If you travel somewhere with the game open, new settlements will have spawned next time. They keep spawning until you reach maximum density.

author: VexatiousWind
body:
I started by not talking. Once you reach a level where you can open a wayvessel, you can create a party and join dungeons. 

If you join a kingdom, you can usually easily find others for party play.
